example.title: Using Pseudorange to Determine Position
lines: Each satellite sends a message with a precise time stamp from its atomic clock.
Your phone receives that message and notes the time using its quartz clock.
When your phone receives a satellite's message, it compares the time stamped inside the message with the time it was received.
The difference between these times is the travel time of the radio signal, called the pseudorange.
This pseudorange tells how far away that satellite is from your phone.
By measuring pseudoranges from multiple satellites, your phone can determine its position through trilateration.
example.result: The time difference, pseudorange, is key to calculating your phone's distance from satellites and thus your location.

H compound interest.context_text: Today we compare two ways money can grow. Simple interest pays you a fixed amount every year, computed on the original deposit only. Compound interest pays you on the original deposit and also on the interest you have already earned. That single difference changes everything over a long time. With simple interest the growth is a straight line. With compound interest the growth curves upward, because each year's interest is added to the pile that earns interest next year. Simple interest is easy to predict. Compound interest is what your savings account and your loans actually do. Let's take a concrete case. Deposit one thousand dollars at ten percent per year. After one year, you have one thousand one hundred dollars.

note.what_was_said: After ten years you have about two thousand five hundred ninety four dollars. With simple interest the same deposit would reach only two thousand dollars after ten years. The gap between two thousand and two thousand five hundred ninety four is the interest earned on interest.
note.definition: Compound interest means that each year's interest is added to the principal, so the interest itself earns interest in subsequent periods.
note.connection: This extends the comparison from simple interest to compound interest over multiple years, showing how the amounts differ and why.
